frequency_question: What percentage of announced strike ballots or strike notices in major banking/financial sectors result in an indefinite strike commencing within 60 days?
membership_rule: Includes instances where a recognized federation of bank unions formally issues a strike notice or ballot with a threat of indefinite/extended strike action. Excludes spontaneous wildcat strikes or localized single-branch actions without union-level advance signaling.

cases.name: UFBU strike notices averted via conciliation (2021-2023 samples)

coverage_note: 6 named cases representing major recent industry-wide union notice cycles; broader historical base suggests approximately one-third of formal notices culminate in actual walkouts.
known_gaps: Conciliation settlements frequently truncate strikes at the final hour, introducing variance based on government conciliation efficiency.
skeleton: Multi-year tracking of formal nationwide bank union strike notices in the jurisdiction, where approximately 20-30% proceed past conciliation to actual strike days, and indefinite strikes specifically represent a subset that often settles or defers due to government intervention.
multiplier: 6 observed major notices in sample window; 2 hits resulting in actual strikes, 4 averted or deferred.
validity_reason: Labor laws and union negotiation structures in the banking sector remain stable over multi-year periods.
